issues.title: Approve pilot operations, account ownership, and release policies
issues.story: Product owner and operators can name the actual rules and accounts used by the connected pilot.
criteria: Record affiliation methods, service areas, handover points, service hours, escalation contacts, retention periods, cancellation rules, pilot limits, and named decision owners.
Record Vercel/Supabase/email/domain ownership, plan eligibility, cost budget and spending alerts without purchasing or provisioning unapproved services.
Document the collection account, permitted collection/payout arrangement, bank reconciliation, charges, and independent financial reviewers. Real funds remain blocked until resolved.
Accept or revise proposed load, notification latency, recovery, and retention targets. Software implementation may continue with synthetic data while financial approval is pending.

issues.title: Connect real sign-in and pending-member private support
issues.story: A test user signs in with Supabase, sees pending membership, and opens a private support thread on a protected staging build.
criteria: Create isolated nonproduction configuration, baseline migrations, generated types, RLS test harness, and request-scoped validated Auth sessions.
Deliver signup, confirmation, login, logout, recovery, session refresh, pending state, and private support creation through UI and server commands.
Bootstrap the first support operator through an audited procedure, allow only requester and assigned staff history, and deny unrelated/anonymous access.
Introduce async typed outcomes and payload-bound operation receipts for this slice. Prove duplicate support-open replay and changed-payload conflict.
Fail closed on missing connected configuration. No persona switch, reset authority, demo data import, production secret, or whole-dataset download.

issues.title: Review affiliation and grant scoped staff access
issues.story: A pending member submits affiliation evidence and an authorized reviewer approves or rejects it.
criteria: Implement protected evidence upload, request/review UI, explicit approved/pending/suspended states, and sanitized audit.
Separate membership-review, support, finance-operation, finance-review, and platform roles. Require MFA for staff.
Enforce live role checks in SQL commands and RLS, including forged profile roles, stale sessions, suspension, and revoked grants.
Approved users can transact, pending users can use support, and suspended users lose protected access. No private evidence appears in public profile.

issues.title: Publish and browse both real listing types
issues.story: Verified members create request and offered-jastip listings and browse a paginated public-safe board.
criteria: Migrate create/list/detail UI to async projections with loading, retry, empty, and validation states.
Persist structured items, integer IDR budgets and separate fee, fixed/negotiable mode, WIB schedule, cutoff, area, and capacity.
Use safe board projections and keyset pagination. Hide exact addresses, other bidders' terms, and private contact/evidence.
Prove owner-only edits and active/schedule filters with separate sessions. Preserve Indonesian mobile behavior.

issues.title: Negotiate offers with versioned consent
issues.story: A member proposes terms and the listing owner can select an offer based on the current schedule and fee.
criteria: Persist authorized offers with a unique active offer per author/listing and revision-bound schedule consent.
Implement offer, update, withdraw, owner review, and renewed consent after rescheduling through UI and commands.
Enforce fee bounds and visibility for only offer author and owner. Replays with changed values conflict.
Test concurrent update/withdraw, stale versions, unrelated access, and both listing directions.

issues.title: Accept offers atomically and reserve trip capacity
issues.story: Fixed requests and approved offers create one order with immutable terms and correct shared capacity.
criteria: Use one SQL owner for fixed acceptance and negotiated acceptance. Lock listing/trip in stable order and use database time.
Atomically commit operation receipt/hash/result, order, accepted snapshot, reservation, order conversation membership, audit, and notification intent.
Serialize final-slot, customer-count and spending-capacity races. Enforce request uniqueness without preventing multi-order offered trips.
Test same-key concurrent retries, changed payloads, expiry/moderation races, and schedule-consent conflicts. Connected UI must recover an unknown response using the original operation ID.

issues.title: Expire unpaid reservations without losing verified funding
issues.story: Members see expired unpaid orders and released capacity even when no browser tab is open.
criteria: Add idempotent bounded database expiry commands and Supabase Cron schedule with heartbeat and sanitized job audit.
Define and test the funding-verification versus deadline race under the order/capacity locks. Release each reservation once.
Make acceptance and other sensitive commands reject expired reservations even when the cleanup job is delayed.
Show server-derived expiry and retry state in UI. Test overlapping jobs and downtime catch-up.

issues.title: Deliver private order chat with durable retry and catch-up
issues.story: Customer and provider exchange messages across devices and recover missed messages after disconnection.
criteria: Create normalized conversations/messages/read cursors with stable IDs, unique client-ID/body binding, and transactionally committed per-conversation sequences.
Deliver text send/history/read UI, latest/older/catch-up pagination, monotonic read cursors, unread counts, pending/failed/sent states, and memory-only drafts.
Subscribe to authorized private per-member content-free hints before fetch, deduplicate events/messages, and perform reconnect/visibility/poll catch-up.
Prove concurrent late commits cannot be skipped, duplicate retry has one message, changed body conflicts, quotas throttle, unrelated and revoked members cannot read/send.
Close settled conversation sends according to the selected policy. Clear private caches on logout, account change, and revocation.

issues.title: Operate private support assignment and escalation
issues.story: Members receive support replies and operators claim, reassign, resolve, and reopen cases.
criteria: Migrate baseline support into the shared durable messaging model without another message store.
Provide minimal unassigned queue projections, atomic claim, assigned thread membership, audited reassignment, resolution/reopen, and escalation UI.
An order reference does not grant the counterparty support access. Staff read order chat only through audited case grants.
Test reassignment mid-session and notification recipient changes. Pending members retain support access and ordinary finance roles gain no chat privilege.

issues.title: Deliver reliable in-app event notifications
issues.story: Members and assigned operators see relevant durable notifications and authorized deep links.
criteria: Implement one exhaustive typed registry of event types, recipient rules, templates, and target rules, with generated/parity checks.
Commit event-specific in-app records and delivery intents inside each owning business transaction. Enforce event/recipient/channel uniqueness.
Provide paginated inbox, unread indicators, monotonic read actions, preferences, and current-permission checks on deep links.
Do not self-notify. Recheck recipient access after role or support assignment changes. Backfill relevant event mappings as feature slices land.

issues.title: Send recoverable transactional email and verify Auth delivery
issues.story: Unread conversations and workflow actions reach the right email recipients without blocking orders.
criteria: Configure verified-domain custom Auth SMTP and application provider, recipient allowlists in staging, and signup/recovery smoke evidence.
Implement unique unread grouping windows, notification preferences, current-access/read suppression, and generic authenticated links with no private content.
Implement authenticated bounded Vercel worker, Cron wakeups, skip-locked claims, lease tokens, capped retries, dead letters, suppression, and replay UI.
Verify signed duplicate delivery/bounce webhooks and provider idempotency lifetime. Handle timeout/post-acceptance crash and uncertain replay outside the provider key window.
Enforce server-only privileged job client imports and fixed allowlisted job RPC use. Test stale leases, worker overlap, missed scheduler, and alerts.

issues.title: Submit and verify manual incoming funding
issues.story: A customer submits evidence and a financial operator verifies actual incoming funds before shopping.
criteria: Deliver protected evidence upload/finalization/download, funding submission and bank-check review UI, independent funding state, audit, and notifications.
Use integer IDR, account-scoped normalized reference uniqueness, operation receipts, and no direct client financial edits.
Purchase remains blocked until sufficient verified funds exist. Evidence upload alone never sets paid/verified.
Test duplicate references, wrong account/operator, conflicting expiry, revoked role, failed upload, and synthetic-only staging operations.

issues.title: Approve substitutions and extra purchase budgets
issues.story: A provider proposes an item or cost change that requires explicit customer consent before spending.
criteria: Implement versioned amendment propose/approve/reject UI and transaction commands while preserving original accepted terms.
Recheck aggregate trip spending capacity under the same capacity owner used by acceptance.
A raised approved budget remains blocked for spending until additional incoming funding is verified.
Test stale/concurrent approval, rejection, duplicate submission, insufficient funding, and notifications to the correct parties.

issues.title: Allocate shared receipts across trip orders
issues.story: A provider records approved shopping and allocates receipts without duplicate reimbursement.
criteria: Implement receipt/header/line/discount/evidence records, structured per-order allocations, and purchase-progress UI.
Lock receipt lines and allocation totals, enforce approved order budgets and normalized reference rules, and reject over-allocation under concurrency.
Allocate shared discounts consistently and show the calculation to participants. Multiple lines can be allocated before shopping completes.
Test multi-customer trips, duplicate and split lines, unauthorized purchase, shared discounts, wrong order files, and partial unavailable items.

issues.title: Confirm delivery using secure expiring codes
issues.story: A customer checks goods and the assigned provider confirms handover with a QR or backup code.
criteria: Implement delivering status, customer-only code generation, provider-only consumption, and accessible manual entry.
Generate random codes server-side, persist only hashes, bind to order and parties, expire after 60 seconds, invalidate regeneration, and cap failed attempts at five.
Consume code and fulfillment transition atomically. Persist failed-attempt counters and sanitized rejection audit.
Prove replay, wrong member/order, expiry, regeneration, concurrent scans, and no secret leakage. Record Android/iOS camera validation separately.

issues.title: Resolve cancellations and amount-specific disputes
issues.story: Members submit evidence and reviewers allocate purchased costs, fee, refund, and disputed amounts explicitly.
criteria: Implement cancellation/dispute case UI, private evidence, structured proposed allocations, review decisions, audit and notifications.
Replace the demo fixed cancellation formula with policy-backed evidence-based resolution and approval records.
Freeze only the affected unsettled allocation. Preserve unrelated confirmed orders and unchallenged amounts.
Prove financial allocation conservation, insufficient entitlement refusal, unapproved purchases, partial goods problems, concurrent transfer/hold changes, and independent review.

issues.title: Review manual payouts and refunds with ambiguous recovery
issues.story: Operators prepare, independently review, and record real-world transfer outcomes without duplicate entitlements.
criteria: Deliver payout/refund review UI and append-only facts with distinct initiator/reviewer enforcement for refunds and exceptional/disputed payouts.
Lock unsettled allocations and transfer requests. Enforce remaining entitlement and account-scoped external references.
Record completed, not-sent, and ambiguous outcomes. An ambiguous result blocks another transfer until account records resolve it.
Test double-clicks, two operators, stale review, role revocation, duplicate reference, cancellation/dispute races, and unknown-response operation lookup. Do not integrate a gateway.

issues.title: Reconcile each order and export the financial ledger
issues.story: Operators can explain every verified rupiah as payout, refund, disclosed charge, or outstanding amount.
criteria: Provide per-order/trip reconciliation views and authorized CSV with safe spreadsheet-cell escaping and audit.
Keep item reimbursement separate from fee revenue and money status separate from fulfillment.
Reconcile the PRD example and multi-customer trip with independent confirmations, partial disputes, unused budgets and ambiguous transfers.
An order is fully settled only when required money movements reconcile. Test export permissions, exact totals, and snapshot consistency during concurrent updates.

issues.title: Moderate listings and collect ratings after completion
issues.story: Operators stop unsafe new activity while participants retain orders and can rate completed service.
criteria: Implement active/paused/closed/removed moderation with reason, audit, future schedule checks for reopening and notification.
Moderation blocks new offers/acceptances while preserving current orders, messages, evidence and financial resolution.
Allow one authorized rating per eligible participant/order with bounded score and private feedback rules.
Test moderation/acceptance races, reopening capacity, unrelated ratings, duplicate ratings, and mobile error states.

issues.title: Enforce private evidence retention and account data controls
issues.story: Members' chat and uploaded evidence follow approved retention and access rules.
criteria: Use shared file validation for MIME signatures, size, object ownership, generated names, metadata removal and private short-lived downloads.
Implement abandoned-upload cleanup, expiry, dispute/legal holds, message tombstones preserving sequences, and audited purge jobs.
Provide account data request/export/deletion operator flow with Auth-session revocation and financial-retention exceptions.
Prove unrelated access, expired links, reassigned staff, held cases, purge retries, and logs free of secrets or private bodies. Obtain approved policy before real-data collection.

issues.title: Rehearse connected journeys and enforce release checks
issues.story: A release candidate proves complete multi-user journeys and rejects unsafe cross-account access.
criteria: Run lint, typecheck, unit, production build, generated-type drift, fresh migration/RLS/grant, SQL/TypeScript parity, and database concurrency checks in isolated CI.
Use separate authenticated customer/provider/unrelated/staff sessions, not persona switching, for every PRD acceptance journey.
Cover authorization and private caching, CSRF/origin checks, abuse limits, realtime reconnect, notification failures, partial allocations, camera fallback and storage failures.
Measure the proposed 50-member/20-session/10-active-order pilot load and latency targets. Record real Android/iOS validation and accessibility evidence.
Confirm production bundles/routes exclude demo authority and fail closed on missing config. Freeze exact candidate evidence and unresolved defects.

issues.title: Deploy the isolated Vercel staging candidate
issues.story: The team can open a protected stable staging URL backed only by nonproduction services.
criteria: Configure authorized Vercel team/repo access, apps/web root, workspace inclusion, pinned pnpm, matching Node runtime and validated build commands.
Use isolated preview Supabase and allowlisted test email, exact stable Auth callbacks, scoped env variables and no secrets in untrusted fork previews.
Deploy a recorded commit, verify workspace package resolution, HTTPS, login/support smoke, and per-environment scheduler target.
Document ownership, current plan eligibility/cost and clean environment reproduction. Later feature slices continuously update this staging deployment.

issues.title: Rehearse backups, incidents, and compatible rollback
issues.story: Operators can stop unsafe writes, recover data and restore a compatible application using a tested procedure.
criteria: Configure sanitized logs, correlation IDs, oldest outbox age, dead-letter/job heartbeat/storage/financial anomaly alerts and named escalation.
Restore database and private objects to an isolated environment. Measure recovery point and time against owner-approved targets.
Exercise additive migrations, rollback to compatible Vercel release, forward schema repair, scheduler duplication prevention and secret rotation.
Prove incident pause preserves orders/audit and stops unsafe acceptances or transfers. Reconcile external email and bank effects rather than blindly replaying.
Record exact rehearsed candidate, operator instructions, backup evidence and unresolved failures.

issues.title: Promote production and open the capped manual-payment pilot
issues.story: Approved participants can use the verified production system with staffed support and reconciled manual operations.
criteria: Record owner approval of actual operations, budget, retention, affiliation, service area, cancellation terms and suitable collection/payout arrangement.
Apply reviewed additive migrations once through a protected job, deploy verified commit, configure production DNS/Auth/SMTP, and verify scoped secrets.
Run production login/chat/inbox/email/private-file smoke with designated accounts and verify exactly one active scheduler.
Open capped real-money activity only after financial readiness, named independent operators, backup/recovery and release evidence pass.
Capture first-day reconciliation/support review, rollback target and acceptance record. If funds readiness fails, keep release synthetic-money only and leave real-money acceptance blocked.
